Teenager Allegedly Gang-Raped on Moving Bus in Noida; Two Arrested

A teenage girl was allegedly gang-raped on a moving sleeper bus while traveling from Uttar Pradesh to Noida. The incident occurred on a bus registered in Firozabad and operated by a Noida-based firm. Following the incident, the victim was reportedly abandoned near Kashmere Gate in Delhi, approximately 40 kilometers from the crime scene. Police have arrested the bus driver and conductor in connection with the alleged rape. In response to the incident, the Delhi government is planning to implement a GPS tracking system for buses entering the city from neighboring states.
